cost.binNote: Wiki states a flat cost of 50 mana (matching ddragon's client-facing champion data). The bin's actual JaxQ spell cost data value is 65 mana. Kept the wiki's number rather than changing it to match; this is a genuine wiki/bin disagreement.

mechanics.claim: The damage lands when Jax arrives at the target's location, not at the moment of cast.
mechanics.quote: upon arrival, '''Jax''' deals {{as|physical damage}} to them.

mechanics.claim: Jax can cast any of his other abilities during the Leap Strike dash, so it does not block the rest of the rotation.
mechanics.quote: Jax''' can cast any of his {{tip|abilities}} during the dash.

mechanics.claim: After the dash ends, Jax is automatically ordered to basic attack the target he leapt to.
mechanics.quote: If the target is an enemy champion, '''Jax''' will be ordered to {{tip|basic attack}} them after the dash ends.
